observations.behavior: Adds documentation about mobile push behavior and release checks.
observations.code_quote: Self-driving pushes use the same `posthog-code-mobile-push` flag as task pushes. A report first appearing sends "New report for you" to its suggested reviewers. A PR becoming open sends "PR ready to review" to the linked reports' active claimant and suggested reviewers, with one push per person when reports share the PR. Recipients must still have project access, and tapping either alert opens the report. Importing historical legacy assignments, including `backfill_report_pull_requests`, sends no PR-ready push.
observations.posthog_connection: Documentation of the mobile push behavior and release checks.
